paragraphs: I am excited to apply for the Senior Software Engineer, Frontend (Auth Experiences) role at Affirm. I am a full-stack software engineer with seven years of experience building financial systems and customer-facing products, with a strong focus on TypeScript, frontend development, and technical ownership.

At Bitcoin Well, I am currently the sole developer responsible for building, supporting, and maintaining our software platform. I own projects from planning through production, work across unfamiliar parts of the codebase, and have onboarded and trained other developers. I partnered with product to improve our customer onboarding experience, contributing to a 47% increase in monthly signups, and have built systems supporting financial transactions, FINTRAC reporting, and security. AI is also a major part of how I work: I use OpenClaw and agentic workflows to investigate codebases, implement and review changes, and automate engineering and security work.

Previously, as CTO of NeurAlbertaTech, I combined technical leadership with hands-on development—leading developers, planning projects, making architectural decisions, and contributing directly to the web platform. Affirm’s authentication work is especially interesting to me because it sits at the intersection of customer experience, security, and financial systems. I would be excited to bring my frontend experience, end-to-end ownership, and AI-enabled engineering approach to the Trust & Safety Experience team.
